method: Every pile, product, connection, line and drafted text comes from the shipped page through harness.js (h.text, h.file, h.detect, h.classify, h.eval over RFP_CAT); per-candidate scores come from an instrumented copy of the page's own rfp-answers script (identical code, three probe lines, wiring stripped) evaluated in the same page. Scripts: run_c4.js, extras2.js. Outputs: inputs.json, out_C4.1.json to out_C4.14.json, out_extra.json, out_extra2.json, run_c4.log.

verdicts.evidence: Pile Adobe services; detect [eds, target] (eds 2 from 'new site', target 2 from 'target'); products eds, target; connection target+eds; lines XA22, A01, TG01, A04. Draft opens: 'Adobe documents two ways to run Target on Edge Delivery pages: Web SDK (recommended) and the legacy at.js. Adobe's martech plugin, available through AEM Engineering co-innovation, is a third...' and '...Adobe measured +1.2 seconds mobile Largest Contentful Paint...'. All three phrases present.
verdicts.cause: detect() scores the substring alias 'target' (ALIASES.target) and the topic alias 'new site' (ALIASES.eds) with no sense check; match() takes the only connection between the two; compose() prints conn.how and conn.gain.text, the partner-facing canvas card copy, through rfp() as Our approach.
verdicts.fix: Agree. Gate drafting on a product-naming alias, not topic words, and give connections a client-voice sowHow beside how, as they already have sowPrereqs beside prereqs.

verdicts.evidence: Pile Adobe services (WORK regex 'chatgpt'); detect [bv]; products bv; conn null; lines L01, L02, O01, O02; sections Our approach ('We would deliver this with Brand Visibility.'), What we would do (2 items), After launch (2 items: 'We will maintain the prompt portfolio (200 to 1,000 prompts...', 'We will refresh four existing pages...').
verdicts.cause: ALIASES.bv contains 'chatgpt', and match() keeps a product's default lines at zero overlap (s = hit 0 + isDefault 2 > 0; the filter accepts isDefault), so any bv hit yields the full Brand Visibility default plan.
verdicts.fix: Agree. A question about the respondent's own tools ('do you use', 'in delivering services') is a firm question (new FIRM alternative), and AI-tool names alone (chatgpt, perplexity, gemini) should not score bv without a brand, visibility, answer or citation word.

verdicts.evidence:
detect [cja] (score 2 from the alias 'analytics'); products cja; lines CJ03, C06; draft: 'Our approach
- We would deliver this with Customer Journey Analytics.

What we would do
- We will plan the upgrade path, implement Web SDK alongside the Analytics source connector for history...'.
verdicts.cause: ALIASES.cja includes the bare word 'analytics', so Adobe Analytics (not a catalog product) resolves to CJA; CJ03 passes the optional-line rule with nameHit ['adobe', 'analytics'].
verdicts.fix: Agree in part: the upgrade line is the one legitimate answer. Make 'adobe analytics' an explicit alias that pulls only CJ03 and states that CJA is the proposed product, instead of 'We would deliver this with Customer Journey Analytics'.

verdicts.evidence: detect [aemsites] (score 1, the three-letter alias 'aem' matched inside 'AEM Forms'); products aemsites; lines SI01, SI02, SI06, SI04; draft: 'We would deliver this with AEM Sites... We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager...'.
verdicts.cause: detect()'s short-alias rule matches ' aem ' inside 'aem forms', no alias or product exists for AEM Forms, and match() keeps AEM Sites' default lines at zero overlap.
verdicts.fix: Agree. Keep a list of Adobe products this catalog does not cover (AEM Forms, Adobe Analytics, Experience Platform alone, Campaign, Audience Manager) and answer 'not in this catalog' when one is named; consume longer aliases before 'aem'.

verdicts.evidence:
detect [target] (score 4: 'adobe target' + 'target'); products target; lines TG01, TG02, TG03, TG05; draft: 'Our approach
- We would deliver this with Target.

What we would do
- We will enable Target in the datastream, add flicker handling...'.
verdicts.cause: detect() and match() read no negation; 'will not use' is invisible to them.
verdicts.fix: Agree. Drop a product whose alias sits within six words after not, no, without or instead of, and say the client excluded it.

verdicts.evidence: Retail Q3: detect aemassets 4, commerce 2, aemsites 1; connection scores aemsites+aemassets 7, commerce+aemassets 7, commerce+aemsites 5; chosen aemsites+aemassets; lines XC01, AS01, AS05, SI04. 'Describe how AEM Assets feeds Adobe Commerce product pages.': commerce 4, aemassets 2, aemsites 1; scores commerce+aemsites 5, commerce+aemassets 5, aemsites+aemassets 4; chosen commerce+aemsites (CIF); lines XC10, XC11, AS01, SI01. RFP_CAT.connections holds commerce-aemassets ('Approved AEM Assets images sync to Commerce products by SKU', lines XC13, XC14, XC15, more XC16) at index 74, after aemsites-aemassets (70) and commerce-aemsites (73). detect('AEM Assets') = {aemsites: 1, aemassets: 2}: 'aem' scores aemsites.
verdicts.cause: match() sorts candidate connections by token overlap with label+how+gain only; commerce+aemassets ties for first in both questions and the stable sort keeps the pair listed earlier in RFP_CAT.connections; the 'aem' short alias puts aemsites into the top three, which makes those pairs candidates at all.
verdicts.fix: Agree. Break ties by the detect scores of the connection's two ends (aemassets 4 + commerce 2 beats any aemsites pair in both cases), and do not score 'aem' when a longer 'aem ...' alias matched.

verdicts.evidence: bank_rfp.xlsx: 14 questions. 2.2: conn bv+cja; lines C01 (s 8), C06 (s 6), CJ03 (s 3; 'Adobe Analytics upgrade to CJA'; scope 'Plan the upgrade path, implement Web SDK alongside the Analytics source connector...'); CJ03 is an optional line of cja (in more), isDefault false, hit 3 from the token 'analytics' in its name and scope. 2.7: conn marketo+eds; lines XB09 (s 12), MK05 (s 6, default, hit 4 on scope tokens market, new, team, run; '...document the new instance setup so the team can run it after launch'), MK06 (s 6), A03 (s 6, default, hit 4 on run, form, site, team; '...cut over DNS and the CDN, verify Brand Visibility, analytics, redirects and forms on the live site, and support your team for two weeks after launch').
verdicts.cause: For CJ03 it is not the isDefault bonus: match()'s optional-line rule (hit >= 3 and a non-GENERIC name token) is met by 'analytics', a word of the product's own name; for MK05 and A03 it is the isDefault bonus (+2) plus the rule that default lines beside a connection need only hit >= 2 of any tokens with GENERIC not applied, so new, team, run, site, form and the stem 'market' (from 'marketing') carry them; ownedProducts() marks cja and marketo owned here but match() never reads it.
verdicts.fix: Agree with Opus's expectation, disagree on the cause for CJ03. Exclude the matched products' own name tokens from nameHit, apply GENERIC to default product lines when a connection is matched, and skip setup, upgrade and launch lines for products the RFP says the client already runs.

verdicts.evidence: Magento: pile Adobe, products commerce, conn null, lines [], sources [], sections [['Our approach', ['We would deliver this with Adobe Commerce.']]]; RFP_CAT's commerce product has lines [] and more [] (its 19 lines sit on nine connections). The three-line Lot 2 paste as given: 2 questions, both draft null (No match in the catalog), because 'Lot 2: ...' flushes as its own paragraph and the context is empty. Two-lot construction (Lot 1 AEM Sites 1.1, 1.2; Lot 2 CJA 2.1, 2.2): 3 questions (2.1 dropped as a duplicate of 1.1); 1.2 reads 'Describe your approach to ongoing support. Lot 2: Customer Journey Analytics' and is drafted as CJA (C06, CJ03); 2.2 fromContext true, products cja, lines [], sections [['Our approach', ['After launch, across the Adobe products in this proposal, our ongoing services for Customer Journey Analytics are these.']]] and nothing after. Bank 2.5: fromContext true, products cja, bv, aemsites, bc (the four most-mentioned in the workbook), lines O01, O02 (bv), SI06 (aemsites): 2 of 4 named products have lines.
verdicts.cause: match() has no path for a product that owns no lines (commerce), and in the fromContext path keeps only monthly default lines (CJA and Brand Concierge have none), while compose() writes the approach sentence whenever m.products is non-empty.
verdicts.fix: Agree. Return null (No match) when no product contributes a line, pull Commerce lines from its connections to the other named products, and name in the fromContext sentence only the products that have monthly lines.

verdicts.evidence:
All seven land in Adobe services with default build lines. The three Brand Concierge questions: products bc, lines [F02], draft 'Our approach
- We would deliver this with Brand Concierge.

What we would do
- We will set up the Brand Concierge experience for the agreed banking or insurance products: connect and curate the approved content sources, design the conversations and guardrails...'. 'How many concurrent authors can AEM Sites support?': SI02, SI05, SI01, SI06 ('We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template...'). 'Does Real-Time CDP support data residency in Australia?': RT01, RT02, RT03, RT05 ('We will run use-case workshops, map your entities into profile, event and lookup schemas...'). 'Is AEM Sites WCAG 2.2 AA compliant?': SI02, SI01, SI05, SI06. 'What is the uptime SLA for Adobe Commerce?': commerce, lines [], 'We would deliver this with Adobe Commerce.' only. Bank 2.3: line F02; draft contains 'set up the handoff (live chat, meeting booking or both)'; the partner note's asks holds F02's second assumption 'The documented handoff is live chat or meeting booking through Adobe Marketo Qualifier (formerly Sales Qualifier), which needs the representatives added as users in the Adobe Admin Console...'; Qualifier appears nowhere in the client's response (it lives in template F02.assumptions, line XB11.scope and the bv+bc and marketo+bc prereqs).
verdicts.cause: match() has no question-form gate: default lines survive at zero overlap (s = isDefault 2) and the fallback lines=(o.lines||[]).slice(0,2) adds the product's first default lines when nothing scored; compose() routes every prerequisite into the partner note and never into the response.
verdicts.fix: Agree. Before match(), a yes/no or fact question (is, are, does, can, where, what languages, how many, what is the uptime) gets a 'capability question, not answered from this catalog; confirm against Adobe's documentation' note with the product's source link; the Qualifier dependency belongs in the response's dependencies, as Opus A8 asks.

verdicts.evidence: Background paste: paragraphs 2, questions found 1 (the Background line has no question mark and no request verb, so findQuestions drops it); ownedProducts() = ['cja']; 2.2 sells = ['The paid Brand Visibility offering, not the free trial (CJA\'s page requires it for the source)']. Forced into a question ('...uses it today. Is that correct?') it is found but owned stays ['cja'] and sells unchanged; 'Background. We use Brand Visibility today. Is that correct?' gives owned ['bv', 'cja'] and sells []. 'How would you build our new site on EDS?': ownedProducts() = ['eds']; detect ['eds'] (no 'eds' alias exists; the hit is the topic alias 'new site' at index 24, whose 24-character window 'how would you build our ' matches OWNS).
verdicts.cause: ownedProducts() scans only rfpState.questions, tests OWNS on the 24 characters before any alias longer than four characters, and ALIASES.eds mixes topic phrases ('new site', 'rebuild', 'redesign') with product names.
verdicts.fix: Agree. Scan every paragraph of the RFP (keep paragraphs(text) on the state), add 'licensed X', 'X customer' and 'runs X' patterns, and flag topic aliases so they never mark ownership.

verdicts.evidence: detect = [] for 'implementing ABV', 'AEP sandboxes' and 'Adobe Experience Platform sandboxes and roles' (all three land in Adobe services through ADOBE/WORK and show No match). 'How would LLMO report our AI citations?' = [] (not cja); 'How would LLMO report on our AI citations?' and 'Describe your LLMO reporting.' = [cja]; 'How does LLMO measure our visibility in AI answers?' = [bv, cja]: the CJA hit comes from 'report on', 'reporting' and 'measure', not from LLMO, which has no alias. Gemini 1: products cms, aemsites, aemassets; conn aemsites+aemassets; lines XC01, AS01, AS06; draft 'Dynamic Media with OpenAPI lets Sites authors use approved assets from a remote AEM Assets environment...'; SI03 scores -1 (hit 0), AS03 -1 (hit 1 under the hit >= 2 rule beside a connection), A02 is not a candidate (eds not detected). Gemini 2 alone: pile Not sure, detect [], no draft. Gemini 3: pile Your firm (FIRM alternative 'status report'), nothing drafted; detect [eds] only (score 2 from 'rebuild'); 'report' alone is not a CJA alias; moved to Adobe services it would draft Edge Delivery Services with A04, A01, A02, A03, not CJA.
verdicts.cause: ALIASES has no abv, aep, experience platform or llmo entries; ALIASES.cms ('wordpress') is the outside 'Other CMS site' whose only lines sit on its cms+bc connection, so the WordPress question is answered by the aemsites+aemassets pair; 'rebuild' (eds) and 'report on'/'reporting' (cja) are topic words, and classify() runs FIRM first.
verdicts.fix: Agree with adding the aliases (abv, aep, experience platform; llmo to bv) and a migration boost (migrate, move, import lift SI03, AS03, A02, CJ03, XC15, AXA01). Gemini 3's pile is already Your firm, so only 'rebuild' needs narrowing to 'site rebuild' or 'website rebuild'; Gemini 2 is covered by extra E2 instead.

verdicts.evidence: detect cja 4, aemsites 3, target 2, rtcdp 1; products kept cja, aemsites, target (Real-Time CDP dropped by slice(0,3)); connection scores target+cja 5, aemsites+cja 3, aemsites+target 3; conn target+cja; lines TC04, TC01, C06, SI02. Draft opens with the Target+CJA card ('A Target activity that uses CJA as its reporting source sends its data to Experience Platform...'), then 'We will build journey audiences in CJA, publish them to Experience Platform, and share them with Target through the Adobe Target destination...' and an AEM Sites build line; no word of partial coverage, gap or missing pair. Difference from DeepSeek's prediction: nothing is concatenated; one pair is chosen and the fourth product is dropped silently.
verdicts.cause: match() caps products at three (detect(q).slice(0,3)) and takes a single connection (conns[0]) from the pairs among them.
verdicts.fix: Agree. With three or more products, list each documented pair that exists among them and name the pairs with no connection in the catalog; never drop a named product silently.

verdicts.evidence: 'How many weeks to implement AEM Sites?': pile Adobe, products aemsites, lines SI02, SI01, SI05, SI06, six Adobe sources, no duration anywhere in the draft; a build plan answers a timeline question. Across RFP_CAT.lines (scope, or the SOW template scope doLine falls back to) only two duration phrases exist: A03 '...support the Client\'s team for two weeks after launch' (eds default) and BI2 '...a 30-day default range' (cja+bi default); both reach drafts when their owner is matched ('Describe your approach to launch, qa and hypercare for Edge Delivery Services.' gives A01, A03, A02, A04 with the phrase printed; the BI2 question likewise).
verdicts.cause: match() treats 'how many weeks' as an approach question (no question-form gate) and doLine() prints each line's scope verbatim, which is also where the two durations live.
verdicts.fix: Agree with the principle, disagree that the trigger yields a duration claim. Answer how long and how many weeks questions from the line's hours (low, base, high, which the SOW already carries) marked as the partner's estimate, and label the source list as Adobe product sources.

verdicts.evidence: Across bank_rfp.xlsx, retail_rfi.docx and mfg_rfp.pdf: 51 drafted lines, 5 lose their own url from draft.sources, each in a draft with exactly 6 sources: retail Q3 SI04 (Go-Live Checklist), retail Q4 XA20 (Commerce Storefront and Adobe Experience Platform), mfg B.2 C06 (Publish CJA audiences) and CJ03 (Upgrade from Adobe Analytics to CJA), mfg B.5 RT03 (Merge policies overview). The title 'Adobe: customer-journey-analytics.html' is the reference title on lines C01 and C06 (url https://helpx.adobe.com/legal/product-descriptions/customer-journey-analytics.html).
verdicts.cause: sources() adds, line by line, L.url and then every entry of L.references before the next line, then slices to 6, so a line late in m.lines falls off; the title is the catalog's own reference title.
verdicts.fix: Agree. Add every drafted line's own url first, then references, then the connection's sources, before the cap; retitle the C01/C06 reference 'Adobe: Customer Journey Analytics product description'.
